title: Roll five dice from a dice cup into the game-box lid
keywords: loose parts in a held container
instruction: Roll the five dice from the cup into the box lid so they bounce and settle flat. Keep the cup rim at least 5 cm above the lid floor as they leave.
context: Rolling dice from a cup starts turns in familiar games such as Yahtzee, Farkle and Liar's dice. This station asks for an airborne cast that bounces in the lid and leaves the dice flat on one face. In these games a die that lands cocked on an edge, on another die, or out of the tray is rolled again. The controlling hand cradles the cup, lifts it over the lid, and turns it far enough to release the loose contents while keeping the dice in the lid. A slow, low tip lets them slide out. A drop in a heap can leave some dice cocked. One arm is enough.
setup: Positions in cm from the midpoint between the arm bases: x forward, y to the robot's left. (1) Box lid of a square board game, cardboard 2 mm thick, open side up, fixed (taped down): 25.4 x 25.4 cm outside, 3.0 cm tall, 25.0 x 25.0 cm inside, centred at x 25.0, y 7.5. (2) Dice cup, loose, upright at x 27.0, y -16.5: felt-lined bicast leather, 83 mm across, 95 mm tall, 75 g. (3) Five 16 mm acrylic dice with rounded corners (4.5 g each), inside the cup in one layer, 1 face up: one in the middle and four around it, 19.5 mm apart along x and y. Both arms start at the ready pose, grippers open. The layout is the same in every trial, as in the screenshot.
scoring: First check the entire cast at 240 Hz (real trial: 240 captured fps from a close oblique view, with a ruler reference). The cup's lowest rim point is at least 50 mm above the lid floor during release. At least one untouched die rebounds clear of the floor by at least 5 mm within 36 frame intervals (0.15 s) of first touching the floor. If the cast passes, count 0.2 per die that exited through the mouth without gripper contact at any time, rests inside the lid with its lowest point within 1.5 mm of the floor and a face level within 5 deg, sits at least 14 mm from the cup measured from die centre, and moves under 1 mm over the last second. Use the overhead view and final photo for contact and final positions. Full score: all five qualify for 1 s. Idle, low-slide and no-rebound trials score 0.
reset_notes: Put the five dice back in the cup, 1 face up, one in the middle and four around it, and stand the cup on its circle (tape) at x 27.0, y -16.5. Simulation: each trial starts the simulator afresh.
fidelity: Rigid bodies, 20 Hz control, release and rebounds sampled at 240 Hz. The dice are 16 mm cubes with 2 mm rounded edges and painted pips. The cup has 24 flat wall panels, and the fixed lid does not flex. Restitution (estimates): dice and lid 0.30, cup felt 0.05, combined by averaging. Static/sliding friction: dice and lid 0.40/0.35, cup 0.60/0.50.
scores: Dream-1 run: 0.0 at the 2,400-step limit; scripted demo: 1.0 at step 332.
